summary.interpretation: Future-visible target-copy plumbing and interface selection only; not useful policy, training, or held-out confirmation.

design.primary: Full16 general; complete original numeral AND closing-boundary arithmetic joint token log likelihood
design.secondary: K1 and arithmetic numeric-only LL; never substitute for full span
design.serialization: Native array concatenation; original prefix/target IDs never jointly retokenized. I2 added inline spaces retained. I4 published text/typo, not claimed author implementation.
design.selection: First256 fixed DEV documents per cohort, no outcome exclusion. General requested512/available512; arithmetic requested512/available320. Fixed Phase1 matrices remain256+256; raw remaining64 is not independent held256 (fresh51/256, short205).
design.selection_rule: Per cohort mean thresholds inclusive, then greatest correct-minus-raw fullspan gain; exact ties lowest interface ID. Report cohort agreement; no posthoc subset.
design.arithmetic_selection: FUTURE-AWARE SUPERVISED CURATION: all eligible cuts128..512 validated against actual RHS; fixed hash chooses one accepted equation/document
limitations: Deliberate future-visible target-copy plumbing oracle, never useful generated-note policy or training benefit.
Known DEV cohorts; six-interface selection is exploratory, not independent confirmation.
Every full-span gain is bounded by minus raw LL; +2 is a COHORT MEAN condition, not a per-item demand.
Arithmetic closing boundary is included in primary; numeric-only score remains separate.
Raw measured once/document; every interface contrast reuses that same actual vector.
design.protocol_selection_statement: Fixed first256 DEV of each frozen512 pool; no outcome exclusion; raw arithmetic next256 not claimed unexposed

examples.selection: First2 positive and first2 negative I3 correct-minus-raw arithmetic cases by itemID; supplied full-answer-copy oracle, no writer

interpretation: No I0..I5 passes. Reanchoring strongly enables literal future copying in general documents, but empty tax remains. Reanchored I3/I5 arithmetic supplied-copy gains are small and their intervals crosszero; other arithmetic interfaces are strongly negative. No useful self-generated policy established.
next: I6: constrained scalar-logit mixture fitted only on separateTRAIN256, tested once on the complete existingDEV256+256 with all controls; no SFT/RL started.

independent_result_review.status: PASS: full matrix, native spans/controls,180 paired CIs/gates/point reductions; public metric tuples/examples checked
independent_result_review.subsequent_changes: Reviewer-requested selection/arithmetic wording qualified; four native-gate receipts explicitly projected. Numeric cell projection and summary unchanged.

cpu_checks.limitations: Repository CPU checks also include unlaunched SFT/mixer drafts; they do not qualify Neuron training or distributed resumption.
